|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 4, in date order). It is not the current version. The current version is [[Slip Sliding Away (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3).
* '''Original''' ([[Slip Sliding Away (V)]], 12 May 2020): Original: the image at the set's official release (22 March 2020; the earliest image in the PC image set is of 12 May 2020). Players Committee card image, 12 May 2020: 0 side [[:File:V12-D-slipslidingaway-original.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a5142dd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/large/slipslidingaway.gif Holotable commit a5142dd “Tweak set images”], no mark). Text: “If you have deployed a site with exactly two [Dark Side] (and no other locations), deploy a battleground site. Then, unless you have deployed a site with "Palace" in title, may deploy up to three Effects that are always immune to Alter. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Slip Sliding Away (V) (Errata)]], 14 October 2020): Players Committee card image, 14 October 2020: 0 side [[:File:V12-D-slipslidingaway-E-2020.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d5f24d6/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/large/slipslidingaway.gif Holotable commit d5f24d6 “oct 2020 errata”], mark “E”). Text: “If you have deployed a site with exactly two [Dark Side] (and no other locations), deploy a battleground site. Then, unless you have deployed Imperial Square or a site with "Palace" in title, deploy up to three Effects that are always immune to Alter. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.” '''What changed:''' “unless you have deployed a site with "Palace" in title” became “unless you have deployed Imperial Square or a site with "Palace" in title”; “may deploy up to three Effects” became “deploy up to three Effects”.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page, 20 April 2022): Players Committee card image, 20 April 2022: 0 side [[:File:V12-D-slipslidingaway-E1-2022.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2640d50/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/hires/slipslidingaway.png Holotable commit 2640d50 “Set 18 and errata”], mark “E1”). Text: “If you have deployed a site (except Imperial Square) with exactly two [Dark Side] (and no other locations), deploy a related (or mobile) battleground site and up to three Effects that deploy for free and are always immune to Alter. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.” '''What changed:''' rewritten: Imperial Square excluded from the starting site; the battleground site must be “related (or mobile)”; the Effects deploy with it and must “deploy for free”; the “Then, unless … Palace …” condition is gone. (The Set 12 remaster image of 20 February 2023 is pixel-identical, so it is not a separate version.) '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E1”, but this is errata version 2 by release order (PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
*: [[File:V12-D-slipslidingaway-20220420-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Slip Sliding Away (V) (Errata 3)]], 21 December 2023): Players Committee card image, 21 December 2023: 0 side [[:File:V12-D-slipslidingaway.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/74a6bd4/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/hires/slipslidingaway.png Holotable commit 74a6bd4 “Dec 2023 Errata”], mark “E2”). Text: “If you have deployed a site with exactly two [Dark Side] (and no other locations), deploy a Cloud City battleground site; then, unless your Imperial Square or Palace site on table, deploy three Effects that deploy for free and are always immune to Alter. Place Interrupt in Lost Pile.” '''What changed:''' the battleground site must be a Cloud City battleground site; the “unless” condition returns as “unless your Imperial Square or Palace site on table”; “deploy up to three Effects” became “deploy three Effects”. '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E2”, but this is errata version 3 by release order (PC-E3); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
